findings.problem: “The former dynasty was installed by the Khitan” is a retrospective statement in the later envoy exchange. It does not establish that the Jin founder was personally active throughout AD 936–942.
findings.action: Remove the inherited AD 936–942 living-attestation interval and hint, retaining only a correctly owned retrospective/political reference unless independent dated evidence is added.

findings.problem: The identification of Prince Yongkang as the Eastern Dan king’s eldest son is an undated genealogical title reference. It does not source an AD 926–937 activity interval for the father.
findings.action: Remove the AD 926–937 attestation interval and hint or convert them to a source-specific research hold; retain the genealogical relationship without fabricated life coverage.
